simd.description: 950DT draft: field structure only; numeric values require DT evidence unless documented as architecture facts.

startup_system_cycles.description: Fresh DT minimal observable SIMD Stage slope, including its completion barrier; memory-transfer startup is modeled separately per logical operation.
startup_system_cycles.note: A Stage setup proxy, not an isolated vector instruction latency. MTE2/MTE3 startup is not duplicated here.

f32.add.description: 950DT draft: field structure only; numeric values require DT evidence unless documented as architecture facts.

f32.sub.description: IR-audited DT measurement. The factor is the measured f32.add vector-instruction rate divided by the f32.sub rate in otherwise identical compile-time-specialized binaries.

f32.mul.description: IR-audited DT measurement; four independent SIMD chains survive optimized LLVM IR.

f32.div.description: IR-audited DT measurement; four independent SIMD chains survive optimized LLVM IR.

f32.max.description: IR-audited DT measurement; four vmax instructions survive optimized LLVM IR.

f32.abs.description: IR-audited DT measurement; four vabs instructions survive optimized LLVM IR.

f32.exp.description: Repeated, IR-audited DT SIMD vexp measurement with one finite-range operation per chain.

f32.log.description: Repeated, IR-audited DT SIMD vln measurement with one finite-range operation per chain.

predicate.cmp.description: Derived from repeated, IR-audited vcmp+vsel and vsel-only DT probes: C_cmp = C_pair - C_select.

predicate.select.description: IR-audited DT SIMD vsel measurement. Stage classification currently does not generate this key directly.

convert.cast.description: IR-audited round-trip conversion measurement; factor is per surviving conversion instruction.

f32.clamp.description: IR-audited vmaxs+vmins pair; factor represents one semantic clamp lowering to two vector instructions.

memory.description: Two repeated single-AIV continuous GM-to-UB and UB-to-GM sweeps at 4/32/128 KiB. Rates and per-operation startup are a joint least-squares fit in SYS_CNT ticks.
memory.note: Per-AIV continuous DMA model. The separate fixed term is required; a bytes/rate-only formula does not fit short and long transfers.

f32.sub.description: IR-audited DT specialized measurement. CCEC canonicalizes scalar subtraction by a constant to fadd with a negated operand.

f32.mul.description: IR-audited DT specialized measurement; eight scalar chains survive optimized LLVM IR.

f32.div.description: IR-audited DT specialized measurement; eight scalar chains survive optimized LLVM IR.

f32.max.description: IR-audited DT measurement using four independent cyclic value pairs so repeated max operations cannot be folded.

f32.abs.description: IR-audited DT measurement using four independent cyclic value pairs so repeated abs operations cannot be folded.

f32.exp.description: Repeated, IR-audited DT measurement of AscendC::Simt::Exp with one finite-range operation per chain. Eight semantic Exp calls survive as eight llvm.exp operations in the optimized SIMT VF.

f32.log.description: Repeated, IR-audited DT measurement of AscendC::Simt::Log with one finite-range operation per chain. The public API emits guarded normal/subnormal paths; each semantic call has two static llvm.log occurrences but executes one path.

predicate.cmp.description: Derived from repeated, IR-audited scalar compare+select and select-only DT probes: C_cmp = C_pair - C_select.

predicate.select.description: IR-audited DT specialized measurement with eight scalar select chains.

convert.cast.description: IR-audited DT round-trip conversion measurement; factor is per surviving scalar conversion.

f32.clamp.description: IR-audited DT cyclic-chain measurement. One semantic clamp is counted as its lower- and upper-bound primitive pair.
